data.narrative:
SiFly is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised $15M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of three same-sector, same-stage private peers (Stark Defence, Singularity, and NODA AI) alongside a broader set of 10 public and private defense-tech companies including Anduril Industries and Helsing.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $15M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, yielding $30M. Peer-median analysis across the three direct comparables yields $400M, reflecting substantial dispersion: the peer set ranges from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence), with a median of $400M. This 32x spread between minimum and maximum indicates meaningful heterogeneity in the peer cohort, likely driven by differences in technology maturity, customer concentration, and defense sector positioning.

The two methods triangulate to a valuation range of $26M to $460M, with a median of $215M. The wide band reflects genuine uncertainty about where SiFly sits within the peer distribution. Stage-progression yields the conservative pole; peer-median anchors the upper bound. Key uncertainties include customer traction beyond raise data, intellectual property defensibility within defense applications, and regulatory pathway clarity. The $215M median represents a workable central case pending deeper diligence on revenue, unit economics, and customer composition.
